verdict.reasons: Core identity and technical evidence are excellent. The required white-and-blue cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton is clearly recognizable with authentic and readable branding ('Drip Irrigation Tape' and 'آبگستر فرایران پارس' under the blue water-drop symbol). The required watermark ('AFP | 09134922013') is present. The scene is perfectly integrated with the article's agronomy context, featuring a greenhouse setting, seedlings, and a continuous coiled drip-tape lateral showing evidence of localized root-zone wetting. No major defects, wrong products, or people are present. The score is deducted slightly only for minor scene realism issues, such as the highly uniform black tape coils and some minor AI texture blending in the soil, which are advisory.

focused_physical_review.reason: A distinct, uninstalled loose coil of black irrigation line is located on the soil to the right of the package. While an independent lateral line is visible crossing behind the package and touching its rear base (line_touches_or_crosses_package=true), the visible front and side footprints do not show a broad uninterrupted soil gap, and the presence of the separate loose coil makes clear_soil_gap=false. No white strips or tape tails are visible on the carton.
